hypotheses.G0_native_replay_is_exact: Maximum native replay logit error is at most 0.02.
hypotheses.G1_data_pca_improves_with_sample_size: Centered rank-64 write PCA gains at least 0.10 from 64 to 1024 discovery sites in at least three layers.
hypotheses.G2_large_sample_data_geometry_beats_stat: At 1024 sites, centered rank-64 write PCA beats the leading rank-64 Down output modes by at least 0.05 in at least three layers.
hypotheses.G3_affine_mean_does_not_explain_weight_a: At 1024 sites, origin and centered rank-64 PCA differ by less than 0.05 in at least three layers.
hypotheses.G4_early_mid_write_is_moderately_compres: At 1024 sites, rank-128 centered PCA reaches at least 0.50 full-logit fidelity in at least two of L1, L8, and L12.
hypotheses.G5_late_compactness_replicates: At 1024 sites, Layer-17 rank-16 centered PCA reaches at least 0.95 full-logit fidelity.
hypotheses.G6_large_sample_data_pca_beats_random: At 1024 sites, rank-64 centered PCA beats the p95 of equal-rank random subspaces in every layer.
